findings.title: Reflected XSS with Filter Bypass
findings.description: The application reflects user input from the 'name' GET parameter without proper sanitization. Multiple filter bypass techniques were required: single quotes, spaces, 'script', and 'onerror' were blocked, but using <svg/onload=alert("XSS")> with double quotes successfully bypassed all filters.

reproduction.expected: XSS popup with 'XSS' text and flag displayed
